card.title: PS5 Standby Boot Sequence & Consumption Analysis

source.title: PS5 Standby Boot Sequence & Consumption Analysis

claims.statement: Feed 12 V / 2 A into the PS5's 12 V rail and watch 10–15 s: healthy is about 321 mA briefly, then 7–10 mA.
0 mA throughout: check BIOS, fuses, 12 V input short. ~15 mA steady or 7→27 mA: shorts near southbridge. ~5 mA steady: shorts near HDMI encoder.

Stuck at 7 mA: check the Dialog IC voltages, the southbridge 25 MHz and 32 kHz clocks and whether it accesses the BIOS—reflash/replace BIOS or southbridge. 7 mA boot-looping to 12 mA: short on 1.1 V. ~35 mA steady: short on 1.9 V.
175 or 225 mA then 7–10 mA: check SSD controller for shorts. ~270 mA dropping on power press with a beep: shorts near Wi-Fi IC. Stuck at ~315 mA: check 3.3 V standby present and Wi-Fi IC shorts.

procedure: Set DCPS 12 V / 2 A, off; clip to the 12 V prongs; switch on.
Match to the table and inspect the indicated area.
card.caveats: Data credited to FixMyApp research; agrees with an existing YouTube-sourced pool card. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
